## Summary

1. Describe the problem and resulting behavior.
2. Link the related issue, if any.

## Compatibility and documentation

1. Describe changes to JSON definitions, API behavior, storage, or Temporal replay compatibility, or state that none apply.
2. Note updated documentation and any new dependency licenses or third-party attribution.

## Testing

1. List the checks run and their results.
2. Describe manual validation; include screenshots for UI changes.
3. Identify checks not run or skipped and explain why.
